text:
alex.k: Heads-up — I have a recurring SDK sync that now collides with our Wed triage. Can we try moving triage 30m earlier (9:00 -> 8:30 PT) starting next week? Also thinking of a short 10–15min owners prep slot right before the call so leads can surface blockers quickly.

meera.s: 30m earlier works for US folks but will push APAC late. What's the consensus on rotating hosts vs fixed owners?

samir: +1 to a brief prep window. For rotating hosts, can we do a 2-week cadence instead of weekly? less churn for owners.

jordan: If we shift earlier, can we keep the triage to 30m hard timebox? also propose this mini-agenda:
```
1) quick backlog hotpick (5m)
2) owner reports / blockers (10m)
3) RFC/design callouts / carryovers (10m)
4) action items + handoffs (5m)
```
Trimming helps with earlier time.

liz: I'm happy to cover Wed of the 2nd week each month (rotate host). I can take the host runbook and ensure notes. :raised_hands:

alex.k: awesome, thanks @liz. so action items: 1) try 8:30 PT next Wed as a canary, 2) add 10–15m "owners prep" from 8:15–8:30 PT (optional), 3) rotate hosts on 2-week cadence, liz picks week-2.

meera.s: small ask — can we add a quick bug-filing window right after triage (5m) so owners can create/update tickets? saves followups.

samir: that helps. also, for RFCs, maybe every other triage we reserve 10m to call out reviews that need +1s and tag reviewers. keeps RFC pipeline flowing.

alex.k: agreed. i'll update the calendar and owners doc. I'll add two new labels in the agenda: "bug-file" and "RFC callouts".

ops-bot: Meeting updated: "Engineering weekly triage" now 8:30 AM PT starting 1956081234. Calendar invite updated.

jordan: tiny nit — please add link to the backlog board in the invite and the triage doc so new folks can pre-read.

alex.k: done. added board link + host checklist. Also pasted the prep checklist in the triage doc:
```
- owners: quick status + top 2 blockers
- urgent bugs: reproduce + minimal repro steps
- RFCs: link + needed reviewers
```

liz: i'll take the host checklist and tweak for clarity. can someone ping me in thread if they want to shadow next Wed?

samir: i'll shadow next Wed. :thumbsup:

meera.s: ack. if APAC folks raise strong objections after the canary, we can revert or rotate times quarterly.

alex.k: thanks all — plan: canary next Wed at 8:30 PT, 8:15 owners prep optional, rotate hosts on 2-week cadence, add bug-file slot. Will post follow-up notes after the first run.

liz: thanks!

ops-bot: Note: no incident active. Reminder: update triage notes after meeting with action items.
